responsibility: Implements the main induction-variable optimization pass for tree SSA loops. It finds interesting IV uses such as address computations and comparisons, builds candidate IVs including target-specific doloop candidates, uses target hooks and address-cost modeling to score variable/use/set costs, chooses an optimal set of IVs under register-pressure heuristics, rewrites loop uses to the selected IVs, and deletes obsolete IV computations afterward.
same_name_distinction: Implements the induction-variable optimization pass itself: the loop-by-loop analysis, cost modeling, candidate selection, rewriting, and doloop handling. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-loop-ivopts.h, this is the executable pass logic rather than the public declarations helpers and entry points expose.
